name: Facebook
summary: Cut off cross-web tracking, reduce search engine exposure, and audit third-party app access.

settings.name: Off-Meta Activity
settings.impact: Facebook collects data from millions of external websites via invisible tracking pixels — even when you are not logged in. Disconnecting stops it from feeding ad targeting.
settings.source: Consumer Reports: 'Facebook Privacy Settings You Should Change Right Now'

settings.name: Search Engine Profile Indexing
clickPath: How People Find and Contact You
Do you want search engines to link to your profile?
settings.impact: With this on, your Facebook profile appears in Google results, making it trivially easy for strangers, stalkers, or data brokers to find your account.

settings.name: Default Audience for Posts
settings.impact: New posts default to Public unless changed. Once public, posts are indexed by search engines and accessible to data brokers.

settings.name: Two-Factor Authentication
settings.impact: A compromised Facebook account exposes years of messages, photos, and personal data. An authenticator app is significantly more secure than SMS.

settings.name: Third-Party App Access
settings.impact: Apps authorized years ago via 'Login with Facebook' still have access to your profile data. Revoking closes this ongoing data-sharing channel.
